content.title: Scenes from Coachella 2026: Sabrina Carpenter, Kendall and Kylie Jenner, Teyana Taylor and more
content.text: Celebrities braved the threat of dust storms and rain to flock to the desert once again for the 25th edition of the Coachella music festival. This year’s headliners are Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G. See all the stars soaking up the sun — including Kendall and Kylie Jenner, Hailey Bieber, Teyana Taylor and more — by scrolling through the gallery below.
